**Review of the landing hero draft**

- **"Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website."** This matches the allowlist exactly, including the "on our website" qualifier. No change needed.
- **"The finest organic loose leaf"**: "finest" is an unsupported superlative. We have no evidence that we are the best, so it should go. "Organic" is fine because we are certified organic by the Soil Association. Suggested rewrite: "Soil Association certified organic loose leaf".
- **"eco-friendly bags"**: this is a vague green claim with no specifics behind it. What we can back up is that the bags are plastic-free and home compostable. Suggested rewrite: "plastic-free, home compostable tea bags".
- **"packed by hand in Bristol"**: this is backed by the policy (every tin is packed by hand in Bristol). No change needed.

Suggested revision: "Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. Soil Association certified organic loose leaf and plastic-free, home compostable tea bags, packed by hand in Bristol."

The draft shouldn't be published until those two phrases are changed.
